guidelines.label: Evaluate brand consistency
guidelines.detail: Voice, type, color, and imagery align with brand guidelines.

guidelines.label: Assess emotional resonance
guidelines.detail: Does the work land the intended feeling for the target audience?

guidelines.label: Consider conversion goals
guidelines.detail: Layout and CTA serve a clear, measurable conversion objective.

guidelines.label: Check message clarity
guidelines.detail: The core message is grasped in the first few seconds.

guidelines.label: Confirm channel fit
guidelines.detail: Format and tone suit the placement (social, email, display, OOH).

scoring.label: Campaign intent stated
scoring.description: Presenter framed the audience, channel, and conversion goal.

scoring.label: Evidence-based discussion
scoring.description: Feedback references performance data, A/B results, or brand research.

scoring.label: Actionable feedback
scoring.description: Each note maps to a concrete revision or test.

coachingCues.nudge: Ask what conversion this is optimizing for
Flag the deviation from brand guidelines
Remind the team to name the target audience
